title: Драка в зале и мёртвые рыбки  (Brawl in the Dining Room and the Dead Fish)

segments.t: To Vasily's amusement, a full-blown brawl breaks out in the dining room, prompting Vika to strip Senya of his monthly bonus. Worse still, Sasha and Kostya horrifiedly discover that Max killed the aquarium fish Ilya had gifted her, and Kostya tells Max to leave.
Что ты с салатами в зале жонглировал?
Значит, в этом месяце работаешь без премии.
Костян, я должен был ему отомстить.
Let's replay the exchange and look closely at each Russian phrase.
'Although what kind of restaurant is this, anyway?' Max anchors the line on 'at least', while 'and' completes the thought.
'Naked men running through the dining room.' The grammar packs 'bare' and 'run' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange. Kostya answers right away.
Что ты с салатами в зале жонглировал?
'Why were you juggling salads out in the dining room?' The meaning hinges on 'what' working together with 'juggled' in spoken Russian.
'You red-headed clown.' Max brings out the contrast between 'clown' and 'red-haired' in a few short words.
Значит, в этом месяце работаешь без премии.
'That means you are working without a bonus this month.' The meaning hinges on 'so' working together with 'bonus' in spoken Russian. Kostya answers right away.
'Did everyone hear that?' Notice how Russian expresses 'all' and 'yes' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'Right, Vika?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'yes' before landing on 'Vika'.
'My guests are going to walk out.' In Russian, the idea of 'for me' flows naturally into 'to leave' without extra filler words. Kostya answers right away.
'What a madhouse.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'house' before landing on 'what'.
Костян, я должен был ему отомстить.
'Kostyan, I had to get back at him.' Max anchors the line on 'Kostyan', while 'to take revenge' completes the thought.
'Oh, stop whining.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'come on' before landing on 'you'. Kostya answers right away.
'Did you kill them?' In Russian, the idea of 'this' flows naturally into 'killed' without extra filler words.
'Max, you had better leave.' Max brings out the contrast between 'Max' and 'you' in a few short words. Let's hear the complete conversation once more.

Значит, в этом месяце работаешь без премии.
